Jamal (CS): FYI customer (org-acme-123) is calling — their latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after today's runtime probe rollout. Ticket #7892, screenshot attached: https://redwood.app/attachments/7892/snap.png. They only see p50 and p90 now. Started ~11:08 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern?
Alex (Support): Do we have the dashboard/panel link + org id? Any quick repro steps from the CS note?
Jamal (CS): Org-id: org-acme-123. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/latency-ops/latency-quantiles?org=org-acme-123 Panel: 'service latency percentiles'. CS says they switched time range and still no p95/p99.
deploy-bot: Rollout event: runtime-probe v2.3.1 -> started 2026-02-14T11:05:00Z, canary complete 11:07Z, global rollout 11:15Z.
Sophie (SRE): I'll look at ingest/transform around that window. @metrics-bot can you pull ingest lag + any transform deployments affecting histogram/percentile naming for org-acme-123?
metrics-bot: Ingest summary for org-acme-123 (last 24h): median ingest_lag_seconds=0.3s, spike to ~120s between 11:06-11:09Z. Transform release 'quantile_rename_v1' deployed at 11:04Z (release id rel-quant-2026-02-14).
Maria (ProdEng): We rolled a change that normalizes percentiles into a single metric with label quantile=(0.50|0.90|0.95|0.99) and renamed old metrics (service_latency_p95 -> service_latency_quantile{quantile="0.95"}) to support the new query backend. Sounds like dashboards still query legacy names.
Alex (Support): Jamal, can you paste the exact panel query that customer is using?
Jamal (CS): Old panel query (legacy): metric: service_latency_p95{org_id="org-acme-123"}
New backend exposes: service_latency_quantile{org_id="org-acme-123", quantile="0.95"}
Customer screenshot shows p50/p90 panels still using new metric mapping somehow but p95/p99 missing.
Sophie (SRE): OK that explains it — transform renamed metric series so panels referencing service_latency_p95 no longer get data. Two mitigation paths: 1) update Grafana panels to use service_latency_quantile with quantile label, or 2) re-expose legacy metric names for affected orgs while customers migrate.
Maria (ProdEng): I can enable an org-scoped toggle to re-publish legacy metric names for org-acme-123. That avoids a rollback. ETA ~20m to flip and propagate.
Alex (Support): I'll put a note on the ticket with the temporary workaround: 1) change panel queries to new metric OR 2) we can enable legacy-names for you while you migrate.
metrics-bot: Config change applied: metrics-legacy-names=true for org-acme-123 at 2026-02-14T11:35:00Z. Legacy metric aliases now being regenerated into the rollup index. Expect dashboards to reflect old series within ~1 minute.
Jamal (CS): Customer confirms p95/p99 returned at 11:36Z. I told them we'll follow up with migration docs. Closing the ticket after confirmation.
Maria (ProdEng): I'll own a small migration guide + a script to bulk-update Grafana panels (replace *_p95 metrics -> service_latency_quantile{quantile=\"0.95\"}). PR will be opened today.
Sophie (SRE): I'll file a short postmortem in eng-sre, add an alert that detects zero-series for expected percentile metrics per-org (e.g., no p95 series for >5 min) so we catch this automatically next time.
Alex (Support): Good closure. Assigning follow-ups: Maria -> docs/PR, Sophie -> PM on alerting, Jamal -> confirm CS recipients for migration notice.
Jamal (CS): Thanks all. :thumbsup:
